title: start_run resets last_sel_* to -1 but never clears input selection — a surviving selection auto-zooms the fresh run
detail: If input selection survives a restart (no clearing shown in this diff), last_sel reset to -1 forces a diff, auto-zooming the fresh run — contradicting the 'no stale selection diff' bird's-eye-fresh-run comment.
recommended_fix: Clear app.input.sel_node/sel_pipe in start_run (or set last_sel_* to the surviving selection) so restarts provably start at the fit.

title: CI and ci-local invoke 'tools/harness.sh palcheck' but tools/harness.sh is never modified in the diff
evidence:
+      - name: Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle)
+        run: tools/harness.sh palcheck
+
+  "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck"
detail: Both call sites invoke a harness.sh subcommand, yet the wrapper script is absent from the diff; if it dispatches verbs explicitly (run/drift-check/preview-check), palcheck falls to usage and the gate fails.
recommended_fix: Confirm tools/harness.sh dispatches the palcheck verb (generic passthrough or new case); add the case if verbs are explicit.

title: Banner card constants (440/17) duplicated in crisis_banner_rect and draw_crisis_banner despite the single-source claim
detail: Both procs still define card_w=440 and line_h=17; the 'shared rect' refactoring shares only the rect arithmetic — the two constant copies can drift apart silently.
recommended_fix: Hoist card_w/line_h/pad/title_h into shared constants, or have the text layout read them from crisis_banner_rect's returned rect.

title: palcheck banner-rect check synthesizes exactly one crisis and passes on partial rect overlap
evidence:
+		cr: pp.Crisis_State
+		append(&cr.active, pp.Active_Crisis{}) // one row -> the rect math
---
+	rows := 2 * len(crisis.active)
+	h := title_h + i32(rows) * line_h + pad
detail: The synthetic state assumes the blessed 65000ms frame holds exactly one active crisis; a two-crisis frame changes banner height, and the on_perim>300 threshold can still pass on overlapping top/side edges.
recommended_fix: Derive the expected active-crisis count from the demo/replay state, or assert against the actual banner height read back from the frame.

title: memlog badge line claims 'ci-local 9/9' while the same PR ships a 10-gate ci-local.sh
evidence:
look-book §6 amendment, ci-local 9/9, self-review (2 hunter layers in-pane after pane-spawn failures)
---
+#   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 10 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)
detail: The PR's own completion record says 9/9 gates, but the shipped script has 10 — nowhere does the diff record a green palcheck-in-ci-local run.
recommended_fix: Re-run ci-local with the palcheck gate and update the memlog badge line to 10/10.

title: gen_sprites aim(): unscaled look-at target makes the top-down tilt differ per sprite and contradict the ~66° comment
evidence:
+    # orthographic, the MM top-down tilt: steep (~66 deg) — the roof reads AND
+    # a sliver of the south wall gives the flat extruded base
+    cd.ortho_scale = 1.9 * pad
+    co.location = (0, -4.5 * pad, 10.0)
+    direction = mathutils.Vector((0, 0.35, 0.10)) - mathutils.Vector(co.location)
detail: The camera location scales with pad (1.12–1.55 per shot) while the target (0, 0.35, 0.10) does not, so elevation drifts ~53.5°–61.4° across the family — wall slivers vary, and '~66 deg' is never achieved.
recommended_fix: Scale the aim target by pad (or fix camera distance relative to pad) for a constant tilt; correct the comment.

title: Rider inner-band width restated inline in draw_packets instead of a shared helper beside band_width
evidence:
+		inner := band - 2*gutter*v.scale
---
+				width := band_width(v, tier, int(count)) - 2.0 * lane_gutter(v) * v.scale
---
+// outline all derive from it (a restated copy drifts and miscenters riders).
detail: The band-minus-gutters subtraction is duplicated in two draw paths rather than single-sourced — precisely the drift-and-miscenter risk the new band_width comment forbids.
recommended_fix: Extract band_inner_width(v, tier, count) beside band_width and use it in both draw_bundles and draw_packets.
